newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan stock exchange pursues upward trend.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan stock exchange pursues upward trend.

text.p: The Casablanca stock exchange closed 0.57 percent higher on Wednesday because of trading in small volumes on the equities market which was running out of paper, a stockbroker said.
The all-share index closed at 486.39 from 483.63 points on Tuesday.
ONA Group, Morocco's largest private group which has a market capitalisation of more than 10.6 billion dirhams, remained unchanged at 625 dirhams.
Blue chip Wafabank gained 18 dirhams to trade also at 625 dirhams.
Consumer credit firm Credor which was floated on the bourse in December, pursued its upward trend, jumping 19 dirhams to close at 654.
Eqdom, Morocco's first consumer credit company, dropped 25 dirhams to close at 850. Brokers said it was a normal readjustment after a two-week jump.
Banque Nationale pour le Developpement Economique was up five dirhams to 168. Morocco is soon to sell 34.57 percent of its stake in the bank. The tender will close on January 31.
Mortgage bank Credit Immobilier et Hotelier rose six dirhams to close at 252 dirhams.
Morocco's second largest private conglomerate Societe Nationale d'Investissement, closed unchanged at 560 dirhams for the second day.
The traded volume on the official market was 65.4 million from 51.6 million dirhams.
